calls.reason: No MathGLM-specific mechanistic study exists in the packet; accuracy declines alone cannot show whether a multiplication procedure was absent or imperfectly executed.
2023 studies show tool-free models failing beyond training complexity (Dziri et al.; GPT-4 ~59% on 3-digit multiplication), and Jelassi's priming found no transfer to omitted lengths.
Table 7 shows an overall decline with an 8-to-9-digit uptick on mixed arithmetic, but nothing tests the similarity mechanism or absence of an abstract representation.

Goat, a fine-tuned LLaMA, reached near-perfect accuracy on unseen addition and subtraction without tools, and Garg et al. show transformers learning linear functions; limited extrapolation doesn't undo this.
Evidence is mixed: MathGLM declines with size, but Jelassi's RPE models transfer addition well to 15 digits; a vague persistence claim isn't clearly settled by these few studies.
